A letter in a careful old hand.

## The Text

Wexley Cottage, the 9th of October

My dear Thomas,

I write in haste, for the post leaves at four and Mrs Pell is waiting at the gate. You asked after the house on the marsh road. I can tell you only what your grandfather told me, which is that no one of our family is to sleep there, and that the lamp in the upper window must never be lit.

He would not say why. He was a sensible man in every other thing, and I have kept his rule all my life without once asking.

If you have bought the place, sell it. If you have not, do not.

Your loving aunt,

Hester Lowe
